name: sled lying calf press
description: A calf press on a sled machine while lying back. Builds the calf muscles.
instructions: Lie on your back on the machine with your head toward the stack end and your feet on the platform.
Move your feet down so only the balls of your feet are on its lower edge, heels hanging off.
Keep your knees almost straight and push the platform away by pointing your toes.
Lower slowly for a full calf stretch.
